extracted.stage: Divorce financial remedy proceedings, next hearing listed
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Crossley Solicitors LLP enquires about a £48,000 loan to fund his client wife's divorce costs, with around £494,500 of assets in dispute and a hearing at the Family Court at Manchester on 24 October 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client. We have noted the request for £48,000 in respect of the financial remedy proceedings, the assets in dispute of approximately £494,500, and the hearing listed at the Family Court at Manchester on 24 October. To take this further we will need confirmation of your client's details, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, details and current values of the assets in dispute including any existing charges or encumbrances, and confirmation of the stage and procedural history of the proceedings. Our criteria and application form will follow from a member of the team, who will confirm what further information is required before any assessment can be made.
